tools.name: discover_skills
tools.description: Returns the URL of the Elite Strategies Agent Skills index, which describes everything an agent can do with or on this site. Each skill is a SKILL.md the agent can fetch and follow.

tools.name: find_case_study
tools.description: Search Elite Strategies’ published case studies. Pass a topic keyword (e.g. "ada", "ai overviews", "wordpress") or leave empty for the full list.

topic.description: Keyword to filter case studies by tag or title (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to return all case studies.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Return verified contact information for Elite Strategies (name, address, phone, email, hours, service area, social URLs).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Return the list of services Elite Strategies offers, each with a URL the agent can read for more detail.
